name: Survey tile in Sextans
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Sextans, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 4 visits over 36 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 36 hours starting 2026-05-12, at wavelengths from 1.81 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
